Description

Rejoignez notre vivier de talents - et donnez une voix française aux histoires du monde.

Pionnier du doublage par IA, Deepdub met sa technologie au service d'une localisation vocale haut de gamme, riche en émotion, à l'échelle mondiale.

Son eTTS™ (Emotional Text-to-Speech) donne des voix naturelles, profondément humaines, fidèles au jeu et à l'intention des comédiens d'origine. Partenaire des grands studios hollywoodiens et des plateformes internationales, c'est aussi la seule IA vocale au monde dont les productions sont déjà à l'écran.

En pleine expansion, Deepdub redéfinit la manière dont les histoires se racontent, s'écoutent et se vivent d'une langue à l'autre.

About the role

Nous recherchons des traducteurs-adaptateurs pour nos doublages par IA. C'est un métier de langue et de son: le texte n'y est que le début. Vous écrivez des dialogues, vous en générez la voix, vous montez l'audio jusqu'à la réplique finale.

Que vous veniez des médias, de la traduction, de la voix, de la linguistique ou des contenus, vous y apprendrez un métier d'un genre nouveau, sur des productions de premier plan. Quel que soit votre parcours, le point de départ est le même : un français authentiquement natif, et un vrai talent de dialogue.

À la clé: une formation complète à nos outils et à notre méthode, et une équipe internationale qui façonne l'avenir de la localisation.

Responsibilities

Vos missions

  • Adapter et réviser les dialogues français de nos productions.
  • Générer les voix et monter l'audio, jusqu'à la version finale.
  • Veiller à ce que chaque réplique sonne naturelle, juste et vivante - à l'oreille, pas seulement sur le papier.
  • Contrôler les doublages générés : qualité du son, du jeu et du synchronisme.
  • Collaborer avec nos équipes pour élever la qualité linguistique et créative.
  • Mener plusieurs projets de front, en autonomie et dans les délais.

Requirements

1. Project Scope & Delivery Management

  • Collaborate with stakeholders and internal teams to deliver projects on schedule and within the budget while meeting scope requirements.

Aretum is seeking a Senior Business Process Analyst supports the centralization and improvement of procurement request processes by developing intake tools, standardized workflows, and operational tracking solutions. This role coordinates with internal customers, program offices, contracting stakeholders, and leadership to improve intake accuracy, streamline triage, and provide clear visibility into workload, risks, and processing timelines.

Job Description:


We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About the Role:

Wiley Research is executing a three-year transformation — from its strong publishing foundation through a connected intelligence layer to essential research infrastructure. The Business Management & Strategic Programs (BMSP) team is the connective tissue between the EVP's strategic agenda and the day-to-day work of the Research business. The Director, Business Analytics & Operations is the operating and analytical engine that keeps this ambition on track.

This role combines two critical capabilities: the disciplined operating-rhythm and executive-support functions of a business operations leader, and the data and analytics leadership needed to instrument a growth strategy in a complex and matrixed organization. The Senior Director partners directly with the VP, Business Management & Strategic Programs and the EVP and GM, Research to translate strategic direction into structured execution, and builds the analytical foundation — dashboards, KPI frameworks, pipeline intelligence, financial governance — without which no data-led growth model can scale.

The ideal candidate has operated at the intersection of business operations and data analytics in a large, matrixed organization, has supported P&L-owning senior leaders, and brings the credibility to act as a trusted proxy across functions. This is an execution-oriented role with visibility and consequence.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Business Operations & Executive Operating Rhythm

  • Design and own the operating cadence for the EVP and GM, Research and its Business Management & Strategic Programs team. This will include weekly team meetings, executive meetings, monthly business reviews, and board reporting cycles — ensuring every session is decision-ready and action-tracked.
  • Serve as a senior operating partner and trusted advisor to the VP; act as a credible proxy in cross-functional forums where the VP's perspective needs representation.
  • Drive accountability across the Business Management & Strategic Programs team: maintain a central initiative register, track commitments, surface blockers, and ensure follow-through on strategic workstreams.
  • Lead high-priority special projects on behalf of the VP, including those involving operating model design, crossfunctional alignment, and transformation sequencing.
  • Prepare and quality-control executive-facing materials — board deck inputs, Research Leadership Team briefings, and EVP talking points — owning the narrative architecture that keeps the team's communications coherent across audiences.

2. Business Analytics & Performance Intelligence

  • Stand up and own the Business Analytics function for the Business Management & Strategic Programs team — the data infrastructure the four strategic bets depend on to scale.
  • Define, instrument, and maintain the core KPI set across the four strategic bets and enabling tracks; replace retrospective QBR reporting with a forward-looking pipeline accountability mechanism.
  • Build integrated executive dashboards combining pipeline, revenue, commercial signals, and operational performance data; ensure senior leaders have decision-ready visibility at all times.
  • Apply advanced analytical tools and techniques to complex business questions — modeling revenue scenarios, identifying behavioral signals, and quantifying the impact of strategic choices with clarity and speed.
  • Partner with Technology & Operations and AI & Data Analytics teams to ensure data quality, governance, and infrastructure are fit for purpose; influence roadmap decisions where gaps exist.

3. Cross-Functional Program Leadership

Mindrift is looking for skilled Bot Developers (WhatsApp Business API, Telegram Bot API, Discord API) to join the Tendem project () and build conversational bots and messaging-platform integrations for real-world applications. In this role, you'll use your bot engineering expertise, conversational design skills, and quality-focused approach to build reliable, useful bots and messaging integrations that deliver a great user experience. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building messaging bots, working with platform APIs and webhooks, and implementing conversational logic.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor bot implementations to improve correctness, reliability, maintainability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience backend, integration, automation, or bot development experience (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in bot development, messaging platform integrations, and building reliable conversational workflows. We are looking for specialists who can design and maintain production-ready bots, work confidently with APIs, webhooks, and backend services, and build stable, user-friendly bot experiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience building bots for at least one major messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or similar) is required
  • Strong command of Python or Node.js for backend bot logic.
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and async request handling.
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases for storing conversation state and user data.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt design for conversational use is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of platform-specific limits, message templates, and approval flows (e.g., WhatsApp template messages).
  • Experience with hosting and deployment (Docker, serverless, VPS, or PaaS)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to bot reliability — no silent failures, no broken flows.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to design and ship complete bots independently.
  • Portfolio or examples of bots you've built (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $60 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

Canada or USA

About the role

Kinaxis Maestro manages and predicts what is needed to effectively balance supply and demand for some of the world’s most complex supply chains. We are seeking a Software Platform Architect to lead the evolution of our Maestro platform toa cloud‑native architecture with experience designing database engines, storage engines, distributed databases, query execution systems, or other large-scale data infrastructure platforms.

As part of the Product R&D organization, you will define and drive the architectural foundations that enable massive scale, elastic performance, and cost‑efficient execution across Kinaxis’ next‑generation backend platform that underpins Maestro.

This role is central to Kinaxis’ platform modernization — re‑architecting core data, query, and execution capabilities to operate natively in the cloud while preserving the performance, reliability, and customer trust that define our platform.

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy

What you will do

You operate comfortably across the full architecture lifecycle - from conceptual design and deep technical exploration to hands‑on implementation and production hardening. You are driven by complex systems problems and understand how to balance performance, scalability, cost, and operational resilience in real‑world cloud environments.

You will design and evolve highly scalable, distributed, cloud‑native architectures that power core platform capabilities. You think naturally in terms of data flow, consistency models, latency trade‑offs, fault tolerance, and system boundaries, and you continuously push for simpler, more robust, and more performant designs.

You will contribute to the architectural direction for the backend platform, shaping how large‑scale data processing, query execution, and platform services are built and evolved. This includes setting standards for cloud‑native design, guiding decisions around distributed systems patterns, and ensuring architectures are both extensible and production‑ready.

You will act as a technical authority across Product R&D, influencing architectural decisions that span cloud infrastructure, core platform services, and data systems. You will mentor senior engineers, elevate architectural rigor across teams, and foster a culture where architects are deeply accountable for the systems they design.

You are a pragmatic, hands‑on architect. You write code, validate assumptions through prototypes, and work closely with engineering teams to ensure designs translate into reliable, scalable implementations. You value clarity, simplicity, and execution over theoretical perfection.

You are a strong collaborator and communicator, able to explain complex architectural concepts to engineers, product leaders, and executives alike. You bring structure to ambiguity and guide teams toward solutions that align technical excellence with business outcomes.

What we are looking for

  • Advanced education in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Deep, demonstrated experience building large‑scale, distributed cloud systems is required
  • We are implementing our own distributed database and query engine, specifically for supply chain data and use cases. We are looking for extensive experience designing, implementing and evolving core database, storage, indexing, query execution, caching, consistency, replication, or metadata-management capabilities in large-scale, distributed production systems.
  • Extensive experience designing and building large‑scale, distributed systems in production environments.
  • Strong background in data‑intensive systems, such as distributed data processing, distributed data bases, query engines, or platform‑level data services.
  • Deep expertise in cloud‑native architectures, including scalability, elasticity, fault tolerance, and cost‑aware design.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical challenges into clear architectural designs that can be implemented and evolved over time.
  • Ability to work with ambiguous requirements and translate them into clear, robust, well-communicated architectural designs that are aligned with stakeholders expectations.
  • Hands‑on experience with modern cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their core infrastructure services.
  • Proficiency in modern programming languages (Go) and/or other high‑performance backend languages (C++).
  • Solid understanding of system performance, concurrency, consistency models, and operational trade‑offs in distributed environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and operate effectively as a senior technical leader.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex system designs to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to find opportunities to accelerate the SDLC through innovative application of AI or other tooling, while upholding architecture consistency, secure design, and code-quality standards.
  • Ability to review AI-generated code rigorously for correctness, architectural fit, integration risk, and edge case support with a growth mindset and bias for experimentation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing platforms that support AI, agentic systems, or advanced analytics at scale.
  • Exposure to Data Fabric, semantic layers, or extensible platform architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with modern cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their core infrastructure services.
  • Track record of technical leadership through internal platforms, publications, patents, or open‑source contributions.

#Senior;

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Data Cloud Senior Technical Architect in Specialized Delivery is a demonstrated thought leader in the technical and functional application of Data 360 (fka. Data Cloud) with cross-industry experience. Ideally, they are a seasoned data-focused architect who understands the Salesforce platform and has proven success in helping customers unlock data and insights. They are seasoned in technical and functional aspects of complex Customer engagements and consistently deliver successful Data 360 focused projects and drive strategic transformations for our top Customers. .

This role is in CSG Professional Services and is a part of the Emerging Specialized Delivery team. Senior Technical Architects deliver best in class complex technical solutions to meet the Customer’s business and technical requirements. They focus on the following domains: Data 360, scripting, data management, and integrations. Senior Technical Architects lead the evaluation of options and subsequent presentation and education of the Customer/Partner. They will also identify and proactively manage risk areas, and commit to seeing issues through to complete resolution. They proactively assess and shape the customer's technical landscape, while partnering with account and delivery leadership to identify and grow new business that align to with Customer success. Being a part of the Emerging Specialized Delivery team, this role will also serve as a growth multiplier to Data 360 talent in Professional Services, supporting and collaborating with cross-functional teams on knowledge sharing, reusable assets, building best practice and other talent development activities related to this high demand area of the business.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert for Data 360, internally and with Customers.

  • Act as a strategic advisor helping to unlock data from customers' various enterprise systems.

  • Help/exceed Customer goals and metrics while providing insights on Data 360 best practices.

  • Ability to work independently and be a self-starter.

  • Deliver high client satisfaction (CSAT) scores by ensuring value is realized through each engagement.

  • Manage multiple strategic clients simultaneously to meet/exceed utilization target.

  • Become recognized as a valuable and trusted advisor by our Customers and other members of the Data 360 community, and continue to build a reputation for excellence in Professional Services.

  • Collaborate with the Go-to-Market team to drive continued growth of services, and expansion within accounts assigned.

  • Maintain a high degree of expertise on the rapidly evolving product roadmap and the broader data platform landscape through continuous self-directed learning.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Relevant Salesforce Data 360 experience or equivalent Customer Data Platform experience, e.g. Adobe AEP, Tealium AudienceStream, Segment, ActionIQ, Treasure Data, etc.

  • Relevant Salesforce experience in Sales & Service Cloud as well as Marketing Cloud, related certifications is a plus (Data 360 Consultant, AI Specialist, Data Architect, Marketing Cloud Consultant, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant, etc.)

  • Data warehouse experience preferred, e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery, SQL Server, Marketing Databases (e.g. Adobe)

  • Experience with data management, data transformation, ETL, preferably using cloud-based tools/infrastructure

  • Data Architect skills and experience such as data profiling, data quality analysis, experience with MDMs and fuzzy matching conventions a plus

  • Strong aptitude toward communicating complex business and technical concepts using visualization and modeling aids. Ability to conceptualize and create sophisticated diagrams and documents

  • Strong desire and aptitude to learn new technologies quickly and thoroughly

  • Expertise in gathering and analyzing information related to data integration, subscriber management, and identity resolution

  • Experience with AI-related data integration technologies and concepts, including RAG, vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases, specifically how they apply to grounding Agentforce solutions with enterprise data is a plus

  • Demonstrated ability to influence a group audience, facilitate solutions and lead discussions such as implementation methodology, architectural roadmaps, enterprise transformation strategy, and executive-level requirement gathering sessions and solution presentations

  • Knowledge of Data Governance and Data Privacy concepts and regulations is a plus

  • BA/BS degree or foreign equivalent

  • Willingness to travel when needed (expected to be less than 50%)

REQUIRED QUALITIES

  • PASSION: Passionate about Customer Success.

  • BEGINNER'S MIND: Always learning; approaches each interaction with an open mind; great listener and hands-on.

  • LEADERSHIP: Self-aware and strategic thinker; proficient at building strong relationships.

  • COMMUNICATOR: Speaks and writes with clarity, brevity, and purpose; explains area of expertise clearly and confidently to others; influences and engages C-Level with authority and confidence.

  • STORYTELLER: Confidently and effectively facilitates and presents; ably defends point-of-view; keeps audiences engaged and delivers a clear and memorable message.

  • TEAM PLAYER: Proficient at collaboration and working with members of a team.

  • URGENCY: Ability to move fast and drive business value and results.

  • TRUST: Trusts the company’s core values; shows integrity, transparency, and reliability.

  • ADAPTABLE: Excels in high levels of uncertainty and change.

  • COMMUNITY CHAMPION: Leads internal initiatives; actively contributes to the Community’s knowledge and resource base.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

For over 90 years, Topcon’s vision has been to solve societal challenges around the globe. In healthcare, we are developing innovations that improve patients’ health and quality of life.

We empower eye care providers with advanced imaging, diagnostic solutions, and intelligent data technology. Our robotic devices deliver simplicity without compromise, by capturing clear images with the push of a button.

By joining Topcon Healthcare, you become part of a growing, diverse, global team. With office locations throughout North America, whether you are on-site, remote, or hybrid, our culture empowers you to contribute to company and personal success each day. At Topcon Healthcare, you can grow your career, gain new perspectives, and help address society’s most pressing challenges. If you have drive, passion, and a desire to be part of a collaborative team, we want to hear from you.

At Topcon Healthcare, we don’t wait for the future. We invent it. Join us.

Learn more about working with us at topconcareers.com

The Enterprise Sales Manager (ESM) is responsible to promote, influence, and sell Topcon’s ophthalmology and optometry software products in a multi-state territory directly and through our authorized distributors. The ESM will be expected to travel up to 50% of the time within the territory and attend national trade shows as scheduled. The ESM must become knowledgeable in both the clinical and technical application of all products and remain current on new advances, concepts, products, and etcetera.

This position will cover the West Region and must reside there.

Job Requirements

  • Past sales experience with EMR, PACS and or Capital Equipment is preferred.
  • Sales experience that demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of the sales process and ethical business practices.
  • A four (4) year degree in technical science or business discipline is preferred.
  • The candidate must live no more than 1 hour from a major U.S. airport.

Working Conditions

  • Work from your home office.
  • Extensive travel by plane and automobile
  • Physical: lifting and lowering boxes and instruments from one level to another (25-100 lbs.)
  • Standing: Occasional 8 hour or more time periods during trade show.
  • This person will cover the West Region and must reside there.

Base Pay:

Expected Base Pay: $150,000 Annualized.

The base pay included is a projected hiring range for a position, level and potential work location(s) listed. Topcon provides the compensation range that it in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position. This compensation range is based on a full-time schedule.

Car Allowance Eligible:

In addition to base pay, compensation for this position includes eligibility for a $600 monthly car allowance.

Sales Incentive eligible:

In addition to base pay, compensation for this position includes eligibility for certain Sales Incentives/Commissions.

Benefits*:

Topcon offers a comprehensive benefit package for this position including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, tax saving spending accounts a 401(k) plan with employer match, tuition reimbursement in addition to other perks and benefits. We also offer time off for our employees to recharge. Our employees are eligible for paid company holidays, paid personal time off, and paid sick time that meets or exceeds state/local requirements.

Topcon reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation; individual candidate compensation may be determined based on individual skills, experience, training, certifications, education, final work location and other factors not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, or federal law. Changes in the position level, location or other factors associated with the role may change the final determined compensation. The recruiter can provide additional information during the hiring process.

*Topcon time off policies can vary between roles which are exempt or non-exempt. For hourly (“non-exempt”) employees, we offer personal paid time off which accrues in accordance with local standards. For salaried (“exempt”) employees, we offer a flexible paid time off policy giving you flexibility to take time when needed, while supporting business needs. All paid time off policies are in accordance with or exceeding local law. Employees working at least 30 hours per week are eligible for our Health and Welfare benefit package.

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Job Profile Summary

Leads multiple business projects and related activities to deliver defined outcomes within established standards. Develops and applies project management methods and reporting approaches that improve execution consistency across concurrent initiatives. Integrates workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholder decisions to maintain delivery readiness and issue resolution. Aligns internal and external resources to complete deliverables on schedule and in line with governance expectations.

  • Integrates multiple concurrent initiatives by maintaining workplans, milestones, dependencies, and governance routines to meet commitments.
  • Aligns cross-functional and external resources to ensure requirements are reflected in delivered solutions and operational handoffs.
  • Presents executive-ready status reporting by surfacing progress, risks, issues, decisions, and budget-to-actual insights.
  • Refines project management standards by improving templates, controls, and reporting practices that increase execution consistency.
  • Drives stakeholder alignment by brokering scope, staffing, and issue-resolution decisions across delivery partners.
  • Identifies efficiency opportunities and implements improvements that reduce delivery cost, cycle time, or execution friction.
  • Validates post-implementation outcomes by confirming deliverables meet requirements and documenting lessons learned for reuse.
  • Leads strategic initiatives by defining objectives/requirements, sequencing interdependent workstreams, and coordinating governance, stakeholder, and resource activities to achieve targeted business outcomes.
  • Translates business needs into actionable requirements by gathering input from stakeholders, defining use cases, and ensuring functional priorities are reflected in backlog, design, and delivery decisions.
  • Guides solution decisions by providing business context, evaluating process and system impacts, and partnering with delivery teams to ensure technology changes support scalable, compliant, and effective operations.
  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, engineering, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.
  • Master's degree in business administration, engineering, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in change management, process improvement, project management, or a related field required.
  • Certification in Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile methodology (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or SAFe Agile), continuous improvement (Lean, Six Sigma etc.), Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Change management within business and IT operations, including policy, standard, and governance design.
  • SDLC concepts and how changes move through build, test, and release.
  • Testing concepts and use of test tools, including evidence capture.
  • Regulatory compliance testing concepts as applied to IT changes and controls.
  • Desktop services and endpoint support concepts relevant to operational changes.
  • Develop and maintain change management policies, standards, and procedural artifacts.
  • Evaluate change requests for risk and impact, identify dependencies, and recommend control steps.
  • Communicate clearly in writing and verbally with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Resolve process and tooling issues using structured problem-solving and conceptual thinking.
  • Organize work with strong attention to detail and manage multiple changes concurrently.
  • Prioritize workload and consistently meet deadlines in a production operations environment.
  • Ability to balance speed-to-deliver with compliance and control requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively across IT and business teams to drive standard, repeatable change outcomes.
  • Ability to build and maintain a product roadmap, driving objectives for desired outcomes
  • Applies knowledge of health system operations and supply chain processes to inform requirements, evaluate impacts, and support solution and change decisions aligned to business needs

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. raw.excerpt: About ShatterproofShatterproof is a national nonprofit working toward a world where addiction never defines or ends a life.
raw.description:
About Shatterproof

Shatterproof is a national nonprofit working toward a world where addiction never defines or ends a life. Through evidence-based programs, advocacy, and public education, Shatterproof works to transform systems for tomorrow, support families today, and end stigma forever. Learn more at shatterproof.org.

Who Succeeds at Shatterproof
Shatterproof is in a period of transformative and rapid growth. We are building new systems, reimagining how work gets done, and creating more cross-functional alignment to accelerate our mission.
To thrive here, you should be energized by building, not just maintaining, and excited to bring structure, clarity, and innovation to evolving spaces.
We'relooking for teammemberswho:
  • Build systems and processes from the ground up and improve them continuously as we scale.
  • Take ownership and act with a builder's mindset, bringing forward solutions rather than waiting for direction.
  • Influence and collaborate across teams, shaping work through strong communication and relationship-building.
  • Move quickly, learn fast, and adapt with resilience, especially in a high-growth, high-impact environment.
  • Are mission-driven and motivated to leave their mark on an organization working to reverse the addiction crisis.
The Role
Reporting to the Chief Financial & Administrative Officer, the Vice President, Technology & Digital Strategy serves as Shatterproof's senior technology executive and leads the organization's technology, digital operations, cybersecurity, data, artificial intelligence, enterprise applications, digital platforms, and technology-enabled products.
This leader will create and execute a comprehensive technology vision that advances organizational strategy, enables operational excellence, strengthens security and resilience, improves the employee experience, supports fundraising and advocacy, and drives innovation across mission-focused platforms.
This role is ideal for a builder who wants the rare opportunity to shape not only an organization's technology strategy, but also how technology, data, AI, and digital platforms accelerate mission impact at scale.

The Team
The Vice President leads a multidisciplinary team spanning enterprise technology, digital operations, data, and product management. Current direct reports and functional oversight areas include IT Operations, Digital Operations, enterprise CRM and database capabilities, Treatment Atlas Product Management, and Treatment Atlas Data Management. The role is responsible for developing these capabilities into a cohesive, high-performing technology function that provides exceptional organizational support while advancing Shatterproof's digital, data, and platform strategy.

The team supports and manages a broad portfolio that includes enterprise technology and workplace operations, cybersecurity and privacy, Salesforce and enterprise applications, website and fundraising technology, business intelligence and reporting, artificial intelligence initiatives, and the current and future technology architecture supporting Treatment Atlas.

In addition to leading the internal team, the Vice President oversees a network of managed service providers, software vendors, implementation partners, and technology consultants, ensuring that internal and external resources are aligned to organizational priorities and positioned to scale with Shatterproof's evolving needs. This includes stewardship of strategic technology platforms and vendor relationships that support operations, fundraising, advocacy, data management, and mission delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Technology Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology investments, risks, innovation opportunities, and emerging trends.
  • Establish technology governance, architecture standards, prioritization practices, and a transparent enterprise roadmap.
  • Evaluate and guide major technology investments, platform strategies, sourcing decisions, and vendor partnerships.
  • Ensure technology decisions support mission impact, operational effectiveness, sustainability, and growth.

AI Strategy & Digital Innovation

  • Lead Shatterproof's enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Establishgovernanceframeworks,riskcontrols,andresponsible-usestandardsforAItechnologies.
  • Identify and prioritize AI use cases across fundraising, operations, impact programs, and administration.
  • Lead tool evaluation, pilots, implementation planning, adoption, training, and change management.
  • Monitor emerging technologies and assess opportunities to create measurable organizational value.

IT Operations & Workplace Technology

  • Lead IT and workplace technology operations for a distributed workforce.
  • Oversee managed service providers, help desk operations, devices, Microsoft 365, identity and access, collaboration tools, and general application administration.
  • Ensure timely and secure onboarding, offboarding, access management, and technology provisioning.
  • Maintain service standards, knowledge management, policies, procedures, and documentation.
  • Continuously improve reliability, support quality, and the employee technology experience.

Cybersecurity, Privacy & Organizational Resilience

  • Lead enterprise cybersecurity strategy, policies, governance, and training.
  • Oversee risk assessments, incident response, cyber insurance requirements, Keeper governance, backups, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
  • Partner with leaders to protect organizational, employee, donor, constituent, and program data.
  • Monitoremergingrisksanddrivepractical,prioritizedmitigationplans.

Digital Platforms, Website & Fundraising Technology

  • Lead the strategy, governance, performance, accessibility, analytics, and integrations for Shatterproof's website and digital engagement ecosystem.
  • Oversee fundraising and advocacy technologies, including DonorDrive and New Mode, and related digital vendors.
  • Partner with Development, Marketing & Communications, and Public Affairs to strengthen constituent experience, engagement, and platform value.
  • Oversee Google Analytics and related reporting and optimization capabilities.

Salesforce & Enterprise Applications

  • Own the enterprise Salesforce roadmap and governance framework.
  • Oversee administration, security, permissions, data quality, integrations, reporting, releases, user support, and adoption.
  • Partner with department leaders to prioritize enhancements, automation, workflow improvements, and reporting needs.
  • Ensure enterprise applications remain aligned with operational and strategic priorities.

Data, Analytics & Business Intelligence

  • Establish organization-wide data governance, reporting standards, and stewardship practices.
  • Overseedashboards,datamodels,access,refreshes,dataquality,andPowerBIcapabilities.
  • Partner with leaders to improve data-informed decision-making and performance visibility.
  • Buildscalable,well-governedanalyticsandreportingcapabilities.

Treatment Atlas Platform & Product Leadership

  • Serve as technology executive sponsor for Treatment Atlas in close partnership with Impact leadership.
  • Oversee current processing infrastructure, operational monitoring, troubleshooting, releases, integrations, data flows, and vendor coordination.
  • Lead the reimagined platform product and technical roadmap, delivery oversight, architecture, cloud strategy, security, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure platform reliability, scalability, security, usability, and long-term sustainability.

Technology Financial Management & Vendor Strategy

  • Develop and manage the annual technology budget, forecasts, and multi-year investment plans.
  • Overseeinvoices,purchasing,contracts,renewals,licensing,andlicenseoptimization.
  • Lead major vendor decisions, negotiations, performance management, and strategic relationships.
  • Develop clear business cases and recommendations for significant technology investments.
  • Oversee the purpose, vendor relationship, users, integrations, renewals, support, and roadmap for Just5, and manage the LegitScript relationship, certifications, submissions, renewals, and organizational obligations.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary technology and digital operations team.
  • Create clarity around roles, decision rights, service ownership, priorities, and cross-functional ways of working.
  • Assessfuturecapability,capacity,structure,andsourcingneeds.
  • Build a culture grounded in accountability, service, collaboration, innovation, documentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate complex technology issues in accessible, business-oriented language and lead change with transparency.

Ideal Experience & Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience spanning technology, digital operations, enterprise systems, product management, data, cybersecurity, or related disciplines.
  • Experience serving as the senior technology leader for a complex organization and developing enterprise technology strategies and roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building organizational capability.
  • Strong experience with cybersecurity, technology governance, privacy-supporting controls, risk management, and organizational resilience.
  • Experience leading CRM, data, analytics, digital platforms, enterprise applications, and major technology implementations.
  • Experience overseeing technology budgets, contracts, licensing, vendor relationships, and implementation partners.
  • Experience introducing and scaling AI-enabled solutions, governance, adoption, and training.
  • Ability to translate organizational needs into practical technology priorities, investments, and execution plans.
  • Executive presence and strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a mission-driven, distributed, and evolving environment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.
  • Deep alignment with Shatterproof's mission and values.
Compensation
The salary range for this position is $175,000 to $190,000. Placement within the range is determined by experience, internal equity, and organizational budget.

Additional Information
  • Ability and authorization to work in the United States required.
  • Ability to work Eastern Time Zone hours required.
  • Domestic travel may be required based on organizational needs.
  • Shatterproof is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: SEO Lead

Compensation range: $2,300 - $2,500 AUD/month

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: The client is a next-generation SEO and performance agency that specialises in working with premium brands in fashion, beauty, luxury, and hospitality. With a unique blend of cultural insight, strategic thinking, and advanced AI tools, the agency delivers SEO solutions that not only improve visibility but also strengthen brand value.

Built on the belief that SEO should be as thoughtful, creative, and brand-enhancing as any other marketing discipline, the team takes a holistic, brand-first approach, treating SEO as a powerful storytelling and growth tool, not just a backend task.

Role Overview: We’re looking for a highly capable SEO Lead to drive strategy and execution across a portfolio of premium clients. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical SEO expertise with excellent communication skills, commercial thinking, and a refined understanding of premium brand expectations.

You’ll lead day-to-day SEO performance, develop AI-informed content strategies, oversee technical optimisation, and collaborate closely with content, development, and client teams to deliver measurable growth.

You’ll also help manage a small remote SEO team, ensuring workflows, communication, and delivery standards remain exceptional across all accounts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create and maintain value realization reporting that demonstrates client ROI, supports executive business reviews, identifies satisfaction or adoption gaps, strengthens renewal decisions, and informs responsible growth opportunities.
  • Align qualified clients with the TruBridge reference program.
  • Own executive-level performance reviews with client financial and operational leaders, translating revenue cycle data into prioritized actions that improve cash collections, accounts receivable performance, denial outcomes, billing effectiveness, and overall financial health.
  • Lead cross-functional TruBridge Financial Health teams and subject matter experts in diagnosing client performance challenges, establishing corrective action plans, assigning clear ownership, removing barriers, and holding internal and client stakeholders accountable for timely execution and measurable results.

All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA, and other regulations, as appropriate.

  • Proven ability to build and maintain complex client relationships, including strategic partnerships with C-suite leaders and stakeholders across client organizations.

raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge's has multiple products - the core product is ambient clinical notes, but we’ve expanded surfaces: billing, clinical decision support, orders, nursing, etc. Measuring quality reliably and iterating fast without breaking clinician trust sit at the core of every single product’s success.

The Evals team owns the tooling, templates, and consultation that product teams use across the eval lifecycle: curate, build, iterate, and deploy. This builds the strategy, platform, and process that enables evals to be fast, trustworthy, consistent, and a true moat.

We are hiring a Product Manager to lead this platform. You will work with 10+ teams and partner closely with engineering, ML, data science, and clinician science. You will help set the standard for how Abridge measures AI quality, decide what the platform builds, and make evaluating a new model cheap and routine as frontier models ship frequently.

What You'll Do

  • Drive product strategy and execution for the evals platform. Own the roadmap across the eval lifecycle and own outcomes against it.

  • Build the shared measurement infrastructure. Help build the systems that let any pod define quality, run experiments, compare models, and watch production. Own the standards for LLM judges, rule-based evaluators, human annotation, and online monitoring, and be clear about where each belongs.

  • Make model selection fast and routine. Give teams a repeatable way to evaluate a new frontier model within days of release, and a defensible framework for when a post-trained specialty model is worth it over a prompted frontier one. Keep the eval system model-agnostic so it stays a neutral referee.

  • Own the operating model across pods. Define the eval gates from early build through GA and steady-state monitoring, which gates are hard versus advisory, and who owns non-negotiable floors like critical-error rates. Land this across pods you don't own, without formal authority.

  • Cross functional execution. Work with Data Engineering on the de-identification pipeline, Data Science on bootstrapping judge quality with less human annotation, Clinical Science on flagged production cases, and the agent platform team as workflows go agentic.

  • Operate with a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience with significant ownership of ML powered products or platform systems.

  • Deep understanding of how to measure and improve model quality, including evaluation frameworks, annotation pipelines, and benchmark design.

  • Strong technical fluency across ML, data pipelines, and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with ML researchers and engineers to drive impact in production.

  • Ability to balance long term architectural investments with near term quality improvements.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear decisions and narratives.

  • A track record of delivering high quality products in domains where accuracy, reliability, and trust are paramount.

Bonus Points If…

  • You have experience building evaluation platforms, ML observability systems, or quality measurement pipelines.

  • You have worked in clinical, healthcare, or regulated environments with a high bar for accuracy and compliance.

  • You have worked on specialty specific or domain specific model adaptations.

  • You have worked on personalization systems, context ingestion frameworks, or ambient intelligence products.

  • You have experience shipping large scale ML products with human in the loop workflows.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Keywords Studios is an international technical and creative services provider to the global video games industry. Established in 1998 and headquartered in Dublin, Keywords now has over 70 studios located across Europe, North America, South America and Asia. Requirements

As a Business Controller, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining the financial integrity of our global cost centres. You will bridge the gap between consolidated group reporting and operational reality, ensuring accuracy in our numbers while supporting the business through insightful variance analysis and robust audit management.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Budgeting & Planning: Actively assist in the preparation and consolidation of annual operating budgets; work with cost centre owners to ensure inputs are accurate and aligned with strategic goals.

  • Intercompany Management: Oversee the monthly recharge process for centrally purchased items, ensuring accurate distribution across global subsidiary entities.
  • Balance Sheet Integrity: Conduct rigorous reviews of balance sheet accounts, specifically prepayments and fixed assets, to ensure correct IFRS treatment.
  • Business Transformation: Partner with IT and Transformation teams on strategic projects to improve financial systems and processes.

Skills & Experience Required

  • ACA Qualified Accountant with 3 years + experience, in a relevant / similar role
  • Experience with consolidations
  • Big 4 audit background, with global multi-national client audit experience
  • Strong IFRS / Technical knowledge
  • Flexibility and adaptability
  • Ability to multitask and manage own workload in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience working with multiple and remote teams
  • Excellent organizational skills and proven ability to work within team deadlines
  • Strong communication and team skills
  • Strong excel and powerpoint skills

raw.description:
Leidos is an innovation company rapidly addressing the world's most vexing challenges in national security and health. Our Global Supply Chain organization is seeking a Lead, Subcontracts Management to support the programs, proposals, and business objectives of the Defense Sector. This role will lead full life cycle (“cradle-to-grave”) subcontract management activities supporting primarily US Government programs which complies with contract requirements, company policies and procedures, and applicable laws and acquisition regulations. This role will support the Decision Advantage Business Area portfolio which includes a wide array of programs across the Department of War.

The successful candidate will provide leadership in Supply Chain as they interface with Leidos management, senior management of suppliers, and to more junior Supply Chain personnel. The candidate will be the primary interface between subcontractors and the program for the contractual management of agreements of various types typically of a high dollar value, risk, creativity and complexity, and will interact with other functional areas (e.g., contracts, project control, finance, growth, etc.) to complete the necessary activities for the portfolio they’re assigned. They will be expected to align subcontract outcomes to those of the program and division, to effectively communicate, manage their time, prioritize actions, meet deadlines with minimal supervision, and detail-oriented who can work both independently and as part of a team.

Primary Responsibilities

The position requires the use of business acumen, the demonstration of sound judgement, and a thorough knowledge of federal subcontracting and experience providing creative solutions to business and program requirements. While not an exhaustive list, activities in the subcontracting process that are responsibilities of this role are: crafting teaming strategy and leading proposal activities, subcontract award, and post-award management (e.g., subcontract modifications, risk identification & mitigation, issue resolution, internal reporting, closeout activities, etc.). Further, the position will be expected to identify and resolve complex issues on assigned subcontracts and make recommendations for mitigation steps to management. The candidate may assist management by reviewing files for compliance and coaching more junior staff on policies, procedures, and best practices.

Basic Qualifications

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s Degree and 8 - 12 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 6 - 10 years of prior relevant experience.
  • Must be US Citizen.
  • Experience awarding and managing subcontracts in a government approved purchasing system including an advanced knowledge of the requirements of the FAR and DFARS
  • Successful track record of using negotiating skills to maximize organizational return, minimize risk, improve price, and terms and conditions position
  • Successful track record of managing a variety of subcontract types, interfacing with internal customers, other functional support staff, and suppliers.
  • Experience independently leading the subcontracts portion of proposal efforts.
  • Must have the organizational skills to manage concurrent projects and possess the business acumen to appropriately prioritize actions and deal effectively with subcontract management issues of varying degrees of complexity through resolution.
  • Must be able to clearly articulate statuses and issues to management, internal partners, and suppliers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Undergraduate degree preference: Supply Chain Management or Business Administration
  • Experience building strong supplier relationships that can be leveraged to assist in future issue resolution
  • Working experience with automated purchasing system (preferably Deltek Costpoint and iValua)

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Our client is a leading provider of HR software in the region.

Role Description

The Senior HRIS Developer is responsible for the design, development, configuration, and ongoing support of the organizations Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS). This role partners closely with HR, Payroll, Technology, and Security teams to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient HR technology solutions that support business operations and compliance requirements across regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • HRIS Development & Configuration
  • Lead system upgrades, patches, and new module implementations
  • Ensure data integrity, system performance, availability, and application-level security controls
  • Integration & Data Management
  • Develop and maintain integrations between HRIS and payroll, finance, and third-party systems
  • Manage data migrations, validations, reconciliations, and ongoing data quality
  • Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytics to support business and compliance needs
  • Technology & System Security (Product Environment)
  • Design and build HRIS applications to operate within a secure technology and hosting environment (e.g. cloud or hosted platforms used for the system being developed)

  • Firewall protection at all network ingress and egress points
  • Secure network architecture for system integrations and data flows
  • Endpoint protection controls such as anti-malware and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) where applicable to the system environment
  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while data is in use, in motion, and at rest
  • Ensure the HRIS application complies with platform-level security controls and secure coding standards
  • Support penetration testing and vulnerability scanning activities conducted for the system by:
  • Preparing environments
  • Responding to findings
  • Implementing and validating remediation for application-level vulnerabilities
  • Maintain documentation related to system security design, controls, and remediation activities
  • Collaborate with HR, Payroll, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Act as a subject matter expert for HR systems and HR technology processes
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to junior HRIS developers or analysts
  • Testing, Support & Governance
  • Lead system testing activities, including unit testing, UAT, and deployment
  • Troubleshoot complex system issues and provide advanced production support
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal governance standards
  • Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, and optimize HR processes
  • Recommend best practices and emerging HR technology solutions

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience in HRIS development or administration
  • Strong experience with HRIS platforms (e.g. Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with system integrations, APIs, reporting tools, and data management

description: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

raw.title: Patient Compensation Lead - FSP
raw.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
raw.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel FSP is looking for a Patient Compensation Lead to join our team from Mexico, Brazil, Argentina or Colombia.

Job Summary

The Patient Compensation Lead in Clinical Development & Operations will be responsible for ensuring all processes and vendors are in place to enable participant compensation, reimbursement, and travel services. This role will be accountable for vendor performance, serve as global business process owner, and work with study teams to oversee vendors, manage processes, and resolve issues. The ideal candidate will provide leadership and oversight to vendors and preferred CROs while serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on global payments and travel services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement strategy on global participant payments and travel services, including sourcing, technology, and defining roles and responsibilities

  • Lead cross-functional efforts to identify and implement improvements to payments processes, systems, and tools

  • Engage with Clinical Development and Operations and vendor leadership to effectively manage issues

  • Develop process guidelines and ensure adherence through QC checks and oversight activities

  • Make decisions on complex processes with interdependencies (site relationships, budgets, regulatory requirements, etc.)

  • Proactively assess payment strategies to align with evolving operating models and industry landscape

  • Serve as Subject Matter Expert for global participant payments and travel services

  • Coordinate with Site Payments and Contracting teams to manage mixed-model studies

  • Lead process improvement initiatives for all aspects of participant payment administration

  • Create an integrated, patient-centric approach to customer service and issue resolution

  • Define and provide leadership of strategies, processes, and quality standards

Basic requirements:

  • More than 8 years of experience in clinical contracts/budget administration and/or clinical project/operations. Specific experience in managing investigator or patient payments.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required; MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

  • Knowledge of clinical operations, protocols and recruitment strategies

  • Demonstrated patient centric approach and empathy

  • Evidence of strong leadership, influencing, negotiation, and management skills

  • Evidence of Clinical Development and pharmaceutical study execution experience

  • Keen problem-solving skills

  • Strong leadership and relationship management skills. Demonstrated ability to effectively lead a team to deliver on common work objectives.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a team-oriented environment.

  • Desire to create positive experiences and make significant contributions.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across a variety of teams and cultures located in multiple locations in demanding/changing situations.

  • Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, sufficient to manage many high priorities concurrently in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Demonstrated study management / data management leadership experience

  • Thorough understanding of the processes required to operationally execute clinical trials is preferred

  • Understands feasibility of protocol implementation

  • Demonstrated knowledge of financial controls

  • In-depth understanding of participant payments, terms and local/regional requirements

Skills:

  • Ability to interpret study level data & translate and identify risks to participant payments

  • Understands how to work with vendors to accomplish tasks

  • Ability to proactively identify & mitigate risks around site level in study execution

  • Country level cultural awareness and strong interpersonal skills

  • Detail oriented & possesses technical expertise (e.g., spreadsheets, metrics & data flow management)

  • Demonstrated experience with industry payment processing software, including developing business requirements.

  • Good business judgment and a strong understanding of the unique aspects of participant payments and travel services including regional and country specific considerations.

  • Demonstrated ability to work in a cross-functional environment with clinical operations, business technology, legal, finance, tax and other functional lines.

  • Demonstrated ability to make critical recommendations and decisions related to participant payments and travel services

Job Title: Senior Outbound Sales Representative
Location: Remote (New York / San Francisco)

Role Overview
We are looking for a motivated Senior Outbound Sales Representative to join our fast-paced, high-velocity sales environment. In this role, you will own pipeline generation through a combination of strategic outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification across B2B and B2C markets. If you thrive in a target-driven, activity-focused setting and have hands-on experience in outbound sales and prospect engagement, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do
Execute high-volume outbound prospecting via cold calling, email, and social channels to build and maintain a qualified pipeline.
Respond to and qualify inbound leads sourced from marketing initiatives, ensuring timely and accurate follow-up.
Lead discovery conversations with prospects to uncover needs, identify fit, and move opportunities forward in the sales cycle.
Schedule and hand off qualified meetings and product demos to the closing sales team.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities, leads, and outcomes within the CRM.
Operate within established sales processes, cadences, and messaging frameworks while bringing creative prospecting ideas to the table.
Support and guide junior team members by sharing outreach strategies and pipeline development best practices.
Consistently meet and exceed weekly and monthly activity targets and opportunity creation goals.

Required Qualifications
Experience in B2B and/or B2C outbound sales, prospecting, or lead generation is mandatory.
Demonstrated ability to manage and convert high volumes of outbound and inbound activity efficiently and consistently.
Prior experience working remotely, with fluency in remote collaboration tools such as Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Asana, or similar; candidates without prior remote work experience will not be considered.
Proven ability to execute outbound cold calling and multi-channel written prospecting at volume.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or equivalent.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with a pipeline-first, results-driven mindset.

Nice to Have
Experience with inbound lead qualification or structured appointment setting workflows.
Familiarity with sales engagement and sequencing tools such as Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, or similar.
Exposure to multi-channel outreach strategies and iterative messaging testing.
Experience in a senior, lead, or peer-mentorship capacity within an outbound sales function.

We connect top talent with vetted employers, competitive pay, and real growth opportunities.

Compensation Range: $70K - $130K
